g.text: Unmarked use cases are realised in both the API and the web portal.
— implemented and tested in the API, not yet offered by
the web portal: UC12 Release Pickup, UC13 Cancel Donation,
UC01 «include» UC02 — signing up as an NGO always creates a Recipient;
as a courier, a Volunteer. The role admin is refused by SELF_SIGNUP_ROLES.
UC05, UC07 «include» UC14 — ranking always runs when a donation is
posted, and again when it is first accepted, to freeze the score the
UC15 «extend» UC06 — condition: the donation is still AVAILABLE or
MATCHED and the caller's account is bound to a recipient organisation.
Guards and overrides not drawn as relationships
UC07 — the accepting organisation must already be verified by an
administrator, otherwise acceptance is refused with 403.
UC27 — an administrator is admitted by every entry of TRANSITION_ROLES
and so may drive UC07 and UC12 on another party's behalf.
The first administrator exists only via the command line
(python -m foodlink.cli create-admin); every later one via UC26.
